Remove formatting as a source of uncertainty

Formatting diagnostics turn the project's readability conventions into deterministic compiler feedback. Calls, chains, control flow, method spacing, comments and line endings follow one shape, reducing review noise and editor churn.

The value of enforcing this family

The rules are intentionally mechanical: they leave developers free to solve the problem while ensuring the result reads consistently across the codebase.

Choose a diagnostic below for its Standard references, architectural rationale and practical bad and good code examples.
